messages:
sarah_oncall: :rotating_light: pagerbot flagged abnormal auth traffic to inference-private — many 401->200 transitions, odd long-tail user agents.

pagerbot: Incident created INC-3490012345. Priority=P1. Notifying oncall and #incidents.

ben_sre: quick look: spike ~180 req/s, ~0.7% payloads include 'Bearer ' inside debug strings. sampling 1% traces now.

olga_sec: @sarah_oncall please assign sec lead. This pattern could be token replay + log leak. Preservation mode: DO NOT DELETE LOGS, take immutable snapshots.

sarah_oncall: on it. ben, which regions and components? prod, dedicated, private?

ben_sre: mostly prod-dedicated us-west-2; small number from private VPCs hitting our log-forwarder. Found one S3 put with truncated tokens in object metadata.

mike_dedicated: Dedicated team taking containment. Enabling circuit-breakers on inference-private, adding strict rate-limit rules on the proxy. Patch rolling to canary.

jamie_pm: any tenant impact yet? which orgs see failures?

ben_sre: a handful of enterprise tenants saw increased 401 churn; one tenant observed validation timeouts causing retries and occasional 503s for low-throughput jobs. No confirmed data exfil outside S3 yet.

olga_sec: immediate actions: 1) rotate service acct used by S3 forwarder, 2) suspend external S3 writes from forwarder, 3) revoke tokens via auth-service. Legal on notice.

legal_bot: Legal notified. Collect affected tenant list and timeline. Avoid external comms until we confirm scope.

sarah_oncall: taken snapshot: /var/ephemeral/incidents/INC-3490012345-snap.tar.gz (preserved). DO NOT ERASE. Handing off direct ops in 12m.

ben_sre: sanitized evidence snippet: 
```
"debug": "...Bearer AbcD3fGhIJkLmNopQ...\n request_id=xyz987"
```
Stored in secure evidence bucket.

olga_sec: good capture. Evidence -> secrets store. Plan: run force revoke on forwarder svcacct and schedule KMS key rotation for forwarder artifacts.

mike_dedicated: runbook revoke (example):
```
curl -X POST https://auth.internal/v1/revoke -d '{"service":"log-forwarder","force":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
```
Started revoke job. Propagation ETA 6-8m.

ben_sre: revoke job at 45% now. Also toggled forwarder writes off (flag fw-write=false) for affected clusters.

alex_backup: ack taking next watch. Priorities: verify revoke propagation, confirm forwarder disable, run tenant smoke.

ben_sre: revoke completed. forwarder writes remain disabled. KMS rotate scheduled +8m.

mike_dedicated: deploying canary filter that rejects debug strings containing bearer-like tokens at ingest. If stable 2m, promote global.

alex_backup: doing smoke: sampled tenant job #93 retried but completed after new token; no replays on sampled traces. Looks stable so far.

olga_sec: executing KMS rotation: created new key version, re-encrypting indexer metadata, switching alias to new key. Monitoring logs for errors.

pagerbot: INC-3490012345 status=containment. summary="svcacct rotated; forwarder writes suspended; tokens revoked; ingest filter canary in place".

jamie_pm: prep customer note draft (short + non-alarming) and statuspage update template in case we see sustained 503s. Legal review first.

olga_sec: forensics tasks: scan S3 uploads for other artifacts, grep indexer and forwarder logs for bearer-like patterns, correlate with auth audit logs, and run eval telemetry to ensure no model-context leakage.

sarah_oncall: handing ongoing coordination back to olga_sec after exec brief. We'll run a blameless postmortem, include eval/regression owners, and schedule follow-up with affected customers if needed. :lock: :white_check_mark:
